_about: The class of each pair from open evidence (proposal 0019, section 1), by validation/python/two_liquid_survey.py --classes from the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive's bulk file ThermoML.v2020-09-30.tgz (doi 10.18434/mds2-2422, NIST open license). Each evidence entry names its article and sets and the T, P and composition range of its points (x: mole fraction of the first component of the pair key); a class holds only there. A predicted split is never recorded as measured. To be checked by a person against the records (AGENTS.md rule 4).
